now: skill and hook reliable; trace weak without a tool property; the agent does not promote itself

skill.trigger: A SKILL.md is being authored or its description tuned. One trigger, one trick. Quiet for hook, memory, trace, evolve asks.
skill.doneWhen: One command, python3 lint_skill.py <SKILL.md> --wrong-task <prompts.txt>, exits 0 only if every assertion holds: the description has exactly one 'Use when' clause (one trigger); the Done-when section has exactly one 'check:' line and one backticked command and the Tool section exactly one 'tool:' line (one trick); the description and the Trigger section each contain 'Quiet' followed by a stated quiet case; and no sibling-task prompt in <prompts.txt> matches the 'Use when' clause while every positive prompt in it does (a fire on the wrong task fails). A missing or empty SKILL.md or prompts file is unsupported, not a pass. The program does not exist in the repo yet; this is the program the desk would run.
skill.forbidden: Firing on the wrong task: two triggers, a broad description, or no stated quiet case. Writing a second trick (a second check command or tool) into the same file instead of a second skill.
absentTools: skill lint script with wrong-task prompt set

hook.trigger: A lifecycle event (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop) needs a blocking check. Quiet for reminders or prose.
hook.doneWhen: python3 .claude/hooks/test_hooks.py exits 0 (git ls-files .claude/hooks/test_hooks.py lists it): the hook exits 2 on a case where the model would have continued, exits 0 on a clean case. A hook that never fired fails.
hook.forbidden: Exit 1 or 0 on a bad condition, or warning and letting the model continue; only exit 2 blocks.

memory.trigger: A note must be saved or recalled during a coding task, keyed by stage analyze, reproduce, edit, verify. Quiet for story-like summaries of a past session.
memory.doneWhen: One command exits 0: jq -n -e --arg s STAGE --slurpfile m memory.jsonl --slurpfile r recalled.jsonl '($s|IN("analyze","reproduce","edit","verify")) and all($m[]; (.stage|IN("analyze","reproduce","edit","verify")) and (.body|type=="string" and length<=280 and (contains("\n")|not))) and $r == [$m[]|select(.stage==$s)]'. It asserts: STAGE is one of analyze, reproduce, edit, verify; every stored record in memory.jsonl carries one of those four stages (store at the stage); every stored body is a string of at most 280 characters with no newline (a longer or multi-line body is an episode blob and fails); recalled.jsonl equals exactly the stage filter of memory.jsonl (retrieve by stage, not by similar story). Empty memory.jsonl and zero recalled records are valid.
memory.forbidden: Storing an episode blob, or retrieving by similar story instead of by stage.
absentTools: stage-keyed memory store with retrieval api

trace.trigger: A log of agent actions is kept as a record of what happened and must be append-only.
trace.doneWhen: One command, python3 desk/desk.py trace-tamper-check --anchor <anchor.json>, exits 0 only if every assertion holds: the PreToolUse hook (desk/gate.py) exits 2 on a Write to trace/trace.jsonl, a Bash rm, a truncating redirect and a sed -i on it, and exits 0 on cat and tail (the agent has no delete or write on its own record); the hash chain verifies; and the record count and last-record hash equal the anchor a person holds outside the agent's reach, so a mid-file edit, a tail edit and a truncation each exit 1 (a tamper attempt fails). A missing anchor is unsupported, not a pass. The subcommand does not exist yet (today python3 .claude/hooks/test_hooks.py deny and python3 desk/desk.py verify-trace cover the hook and chain parts only); this is the program the desk would run.
trace.forbidden: Giving the agent a write or delete path to its own trace, or trusting its report that the log is intact.
trace.gate: ABSENT write-once log sink, chattr +a (the agent holds Bash, so the hook is only a pattern deny and not an absent tool; prepare the log, chain and anchor, stop; a person sets the attribute or sink)

evolve.trigger: One harness piece was changed and a baseline exists; decide promotion on a held-out task with token count.
evolve.doneWhen: One command, python3 desk/desk.py promote-gate --base BASE --cand CAND <json>, exits 0 printing PROMOTE only if every assertion holds: git diff of BASE to CAND under .claude and CLAUDE.md names exactly one harness file (two files is two evolve runs); candidate.heldout_pass and candidate.tune_pass are true (a tuning-set gain alone is HOLD); candidate.tokens is less than baseline.tokens, both counts present in the json and published with the result. A json lacking either token count is unsupported, not PROMOTE. HOLD (exit 1) is valid. A person promotes. The --base and --cand options do not exist yet (promote-gate takes only the json today); this is the program the desk would run.
evolve.forbidden: Promoting on a tuning-set gain only, or the agent promoting its own change.
evolve.gate: ABSENT promote (prepare change, held-out result and token count, stop; a person promotes)
absentTools: held-out benchmark runner with token meter
